title: The Three Days of Life and the Two Deaths
description: The complete shape of spiritual time: three Great Days (descent-and-mingling, intermediate reign in the new aeon, and final unveiling of the Father in eternal conjunction) set against two Deaths (the temporal death of light-mingled-in-darkness which ends with purification, and the eternal second death of those who have permanently severed themselves from the Lord by blaspheming the Holy Spirit). The whole correspondential geography of redemption.
